package saga

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestReviewNewSagaLifetimeMustNotReplayPreviousReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	u := newUnitPartition(t, func(o *Options) { o.TerminalRetention = time.Minute })
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	u.clock.Set(now)
	h := newNativeHarness()
	r := u.round(now, u.startInput("reuse", []byte("old"), "first", ""))
	first := *r.events[0].Command
	out := h.run(t, first)
	r = u.round(now.Add(time.Millisecond), u.resultInput(out.Completion))
	out = h.run(t, *r.events[len(r.events)-1].Command)
	u.round(now.Add(2*time.Millisecond), u.resultInput(out.Completion))
	if u.record(first.SagaID).Status != StatusCompleted {
		t.Fatal("first not done")
	}
	next := now.Add(2 * time.Minute)
	u.p.prune(next)
	if u.p.sagas[first.SagaID] != nil {
		t.Fatal("not pruned")
	}
	r = u.round(next, u.startInput("reuse", []byte("new"), "second", ""))
	second := *r.events[0].Command
	before := h.business
	out = h.run(t, second)
	if h.business != before+1 || out.Kind != StepExecuted {
		t.Fatalf("new lifetime skipped: old=%s new=%s oldOp=%s newOp=%s kind=%d business=%d->%d completionData=%q", first.ID, second.ID, first.IdempotencyKey, second.IdempotencyKey, out.Kind, before, h.business, out.Completion.Data)
	}
}
func TestReviewPreviousLifetimeCompletionMustNotAdvanceNewSaga(t *testing.T) {
	u := newUnitPartition(t, func(o *Options) { o.TerminalRetention = time.Minute })
	now := u.clock.Now()
	r := u.round(now, u.startInput("reuse-result", []byte("old"), "first", ""))
	old := *r.events[0].Command
	oldResult := Completion{CommandID: old.ID, IdempotencyKey: old.IdempotencyKey, SagaID: old.SagaID, Success: true, Data: []byte("old-result")}
	r = u.round(now.Add(time.Millisecond), u.resultInput(oldResult))
	second := r.events[len(r.events)-1].Command
	u.round(now.Add(2*time.Millisecond), u.resultInput(Completion{CommandID: second.ID, IdempotencyKey: second.IdempotencyKey, SagaID: second.SagaID, Success: true}))
	next := now.Add(2 * time.Minute)
	u.p.prune(next)
	u.round(next, u.startInput("reuse-result", []byte("new"), "second", ""))
	before := u.record(old.SagaID)
	u.round(next.Add(time.Millisecond), u.resultInput(oldResult))
	after := u.record(old.SagaID)
	if after.Step != before.Step || after.Version != before.Version {
		t.Fatalf("old lifetime result advanced new saga: step %d->%d version %d->%d data=%q", before.Step, after.Step, before.Version, after.Version, after.Data)
	}
}
